text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Ah!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I've found you! ♪ Heeey!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fine Motion suddenly runs off towards the stands in the middle of training!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: For the love of… You know you don't have to come over every time you see me, right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I look up to see Air Shakur, a highly logical Umamusume who made her debut before Fine Motion, in the stands.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Oh? But I thought that's why you came here, Shakur. To see me.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: What?!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: You mean you're not collecting data on me again?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's a reason she said "again." I've spotted Air Shakur with her laptop numerous times while Fine Motion has been training.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: …Figured you didn't mind since you never said anything. What, do I need security clearance or something?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: That's not what I meant! I'm saying that if you're going to do that, then we should just train together!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Don't you think you'll gather data more efficiently that way?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Yeah, but it'll come at the cost of having to engage with you more. No thanks.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Engage? Is that like "going steady"? We don't have to do that if you don't want to. Let's just talk!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Hey! You're her trainer, aren't you? Shouldn't you teach her not to stick her nose into other people's business?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Are you kidding?! Doesn't that go without saying?!
choice_data_list: Then, why are you collecting data on her?
Then, why are you collecting data on her?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Because it's necessary, duh. Accurate numbers never lie.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: For example, you know about the research regarding the connection between genes and race-distance aptitude, right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The research she mentions is well-known in the racing world. It theorizes that you can determine distance aptitude based on the number of genes that suppress muscle cells.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: In order to understand that trend, I need a large number of samples. Numbers are king in this discussion.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: But unlike a certain romanticist, I'm not just in it for the sake of progress or whatever.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: I believe everything is predetermined… but simply following along sounds like a drag. What's the fun in playing a game when you already know the ending?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: I'd rather see what happens when I find a bug in the system… And to do that, I need all the data I can get my hands on.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: And that… includes data on any weird outliers that might exist.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hm? You mean me?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Why else would I be interested in you? Your data's got some weird fluctuations.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Fluctuations that don't abide by the rules. If I could just use that to my advantage…

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Then maybe those seven centimeters would change. Although, there's no telling if that gap would shrink or grow.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seven centimeters… A distance that no doubt stirs up feelings of despair within Air Shakur.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After winning the Satsuki Sho, she was on the verge of taking home her second crown at the Japanese Derby but lost by a distance of only seven centimeters.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She later won the Kikuka Sho and became a Double Crown champion, but…

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: "Data doesn't lie… What it says, goes. What better proof do you need than this?"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Those were the only words she muttered at her post-race press conference before leaving the podium.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Shakur…

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: …Damn it. I've said too much.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hey, wait!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: What? If you say something idiotic, I'll knock some sense into you.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Or could it be that the ever-merciful princess desires some kind of compensation for the data I've collected?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I don't care about the data. I just…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I'd just like to talk with you a little more.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: No thanks. How about you chitchat with your trainer over there?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Hey, you! …Make sure you keep an eye on her.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: I mean, don't let her just fool around aimlessly… duh.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Your job is to keep her running right up until the very end.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Shakur never changes, does she? She certainly has a unique way of communicating.
choice_data_list: You like that about her, right?
You like that about her, right?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hehe, can you tell?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: That's right. Shakur is different from everyone else I've grown close to at this academy.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: It's not just how she acts—though I do love that aspect of her, of course.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I suppose the biggest thing is… that I can respect her.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Even if it only leads her to despair, she'll never stop analyzing and theorizing.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Not to mention how cool and clever she is. How could I not like her?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's certainly a sense of respect emanating from Fine Motion as she talks about Air Shakur.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But how does Air Shakur feel? She seems to have taken interest in Fine Motion's inherent ability and analyzing her, but…

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: And that… includes data on any weird outliers that might exist.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Perhaps she sees something in Fine Motion—something more than just fluctuations in data.
